name: Invasion Tree
description: The structure on New Phyrexia whose barbs retract and which becomes the site of the final battle.

timeline.summary: The Invasion Tree's branches shrivel as angels with Halo are unleashed into the Multiverse through the portals.
timeline.quote: "The angels are being unleashed into the Multiverse, bringing the power of Halo with them."

timeline.summary: Tazri commands Sea Gate's defenders against waves of Phyrexians from the Invasion Tree's branches.
timeline.quote: "This is our home! We've killed false gods for it! No invader will ever claim it from us!"

timeline.summary: With Atraxa dead, the Invasion Tree's barbs retract and the angels see portals open to Theros and decide to go help.
timeline.quote: Atraxa's death has changed New Phyrexia

pages_say.description: A tree-like Phyrexian monument on Mirrodin that pierces the heavens, testament to Elesh Norn's triumphs.
The Phyrexian structure on Mirrodin that the Mirrans must reach to escape.
The giant white-plated tree Wrenn must graft onto to reach Teferi.
The branching Phyrexian tree overgrowing New Capenna's sky.
The tree whose branches burst from portals in Zendikar's sky and sea.
The structure on New Phyrexia whose barbs retract and which becomes the site of the final battle.
The Phyrexian tree Nissa spoke Phyrexia's glory through and Wrenn bound herself to.
